title: Aerial Transitions: Clone-Paint Layer Workflow for Subtle Landscape Edits
summary: The video demonstrates a Photoshop-based clone-paint workflow on a high-contrast landscape image (mountain and cloud scene). The author starts with a global Gaussian blur to smooth extreme tonal Separation, then uses a History Brush to reintroduce darker tones in the background. A dedicated clone-paint layer is created and populated with multiple adjustments, particularly highlight-focused split-toning, which are selectively brushed onto the image to shape warmth, diffusion, and edge diffusion. The process emphasizes guiding the viewer’s eye by deliberate edge treatment, building light and color transitions, and finally reintroducing some of the original tonal information to balance the edit.

sections.title: Global smoothing with Gaussian Blur
sections.description: Apply a 220-pixel radius Gaussian blur at 30% opacity across the entire image to reduce high-contrast harshness and create smoother tonal transitions.

sections.title: Selective darks restoration with History Brush
sections.description: Reintroduce darker tones in background areas behind the mountain using the History Brush; no selection was needed.

sections.title: Clone Paint layer setup with multiple adjustments
sections.description: Create a Clone Paint layer and generate four additional adjustments to control tone and color in a modular, brushable way.

sections.title: Selective brushing and mixing of clone-paint adjustments
sections.description: Choose which adjustments to brush onto the image and blend them, enabling a progressive evolution of the edit.

sections.title: Warmth, diffusion, and darkness tuning
sections.description: Brush in adjustments to add warmth and diffusion and selectively influence darkness in targeted areas.

sections.title: Edge control for viewer guidance
sections.description: Alternate between edge control and softer edges; diffusion around edges helps focus viewer attention on the subject.

sections.title: Building light and color transitions
sections.description: Continue building light and color transitions across the image with selective application to certain areas.

sections.title: Final balance with original tones
sections.description: Finish by reintroducing a portion of the original tonal information to balance the edits.
